The quote states changes not applied immediately go to the pending modifications queue, are applied in the next maintenance window, and apply immediately applies the new and queued changes.

The quotas page quote states backups managed by AWS Backup are considered manual DB snapshots but don't count toward the manual snapshot quota.
The quotes state automated backups occur daily in the preferred backup window and a longer backup continues after the window ends until it finishes.
The FAQ quote states primary data storage is in a single AZ and backup data including transaction logs is replicated across multiple AZs for durability.

The quote states an outage occurs when the retention period of a DB instance changes from 0 to nonzero or from nonzero to 0.
